notes.title: Update the notice, but I don't know when it is.
notes.content:
It's been a long time.

The development is now only 80%, and maybe a month or two months to release a new version. I don't know when it will be. It's unforeseeable.

Now I want to publish a few new versions of the game pictures, but the Internet is so bad.

Anyway, I'd like to introduce the new content, the new version of the update is:
1.A new login interface and UI.
2.The biggest support is the waiting room for 64 players.
3.New game map (Zombie: protecting magic animals)
---This is a multi - person shooting cooperative game
---There are 5 jobs now, with different abilities.
---Including building systems.
---Real environment, time / bird / butterfly / fish ,I think it's very close to reality.

I made GIF pictures, but I couldn't upload them all the time. It was really bad.
If you want to download, you can download two GIF pictures at the following address, and I upload it to OneDrive.
gif1:   https://1drv.ms/i/s!Ao4MAWV7AKN7gQj2_T8FcsEf8jv6
gif2:   https://1drv.ms/i/s!Ao4MAWV7AKN7gQlzVciKP4waNwia

Thank you very much for your attention and support, and I will continue to work hard.

Grean 2018/01/03 23:48

notes.title: The price application has been passed and is now on sale at 0.99$
notes.content:
After a month of continuous application, the new price has passed the application.

In fact, we are preparing to update a new MOD, which is expected to launch a new MOD within 20 days, and make the following changes:
1.Change multiplayer room initial to MOD internal map.
2.Scene for changing a single room.
3.Change the original UI design and adopt the new design of GUI.

We'll release the new version as soon as possible. If it's too late, maybe we'll give priority to some of the content.

2017/09/19 17:17
